limits: All20heads exceed requested55–65%cellheight; actual source heights198–233px(77.3–91.0%).

Nominal headSource scale.06 would enlarge these heads versus v381; parent must fit unchanged source neck/crown to existing displayed head height using explicit uniform scale, not claim equal raw pixel scale.
Face polygons are conservative manually observed graphic regions with8px uncertainty, not alpha/skin extraction or3D surface proof.
Backworker neck center is inferred behind short braid; visible side neck samples should govern future fit.
Alpha1 background wisps/connected ghosts remain preserved. Crops keep all principalalpha16 pixels but do not remove low-alpha noise.
Five role designs do not establish20bodymodels or action animations. No hood/helmet fit or game rendering accepted here.
